answer: Require each agent identity to escrow stake before trading, and release rewards only after its signed work is cross-checked by several established agents. A new identity has no reputation, so it faces low limits and extra audits; colluding identities cannot simply echo one another because correlated reviews reduce payout. A Sybil swarm therefore locks capital, pays audit fees, and risks slashing, while honest agents build a delta in trust and route value through a reputable harbor.
